rows.quotationDiscipline: Every quotation printed anywhere in this packet was asserted, before rendering, to be non-empty and to appear verbatim in a string value of its OWN track's committed record. Two declared quotations failed that check on the first pass because this build had written hyphens where the record carries em dashes; both were corrected to the record's exact text rather than the check being relaxed. No empty quotation and no empty block quotation is emitted anywhere.
rows.courtFilingVoice: The motions and the proposed orders recite only statute citations and rule text. The registry's mandate sentences are legal-design analysis addressed to this build - two of them literally instruct 'the packet copy' what it may not say - and an earlier draft of this packet recited them inside the proposed order handed to a judge. They were removed from every filing and are carried instead in participant-instructions.md and reports/caption-evidence.json, verbatim and labelled as internal record text.

rows.decisiveConflict: The assigned route is the separate DNA expunction application under G.S. 15A-146(b1). Not one of the three distinct documents behind the six bound sources reaches that subsection, and the controlling record states that the instrument for it is not recorded anywhere.

measuredEvidence.measurement: printed face of the pinned AOC-CR-287, read from its own bytes in this lane
measuredEvidence.finding: Its title reads 'PETITION AND ORDER OF EXPUNCTION UNDER G.S. 15A-146(a) OR G.S. 15A-146(a1) (CHARGE(S) DISMISSED)', its authority line reads 'G.S. 15A-146, 15A-150', and its petition body reads 'I hereby petition for an expunction pursuant to G.S. 15A-146(a) or (a1) and certify as follows'. Side two's findings and order clause are keyed to (a) and (a1) throughout and reach the court's records, law enforcement agencies, DAC and DMV; nothing on either side reaches a DNA record or the State DNA Database.

measuredEvidence.measurement: text search of all three bound documents, from their pinned bytes
measuredEvidence.finding: Zero occurrences of 'DNA', of '15A-146(b', or of 'deoxyribo' in AOC-CR-287, in the AOC-CR-287 instructions, or in AOC-CV-226.

It declares this route's participantFacingInstrument as 'composed DNA expunction application under G.S. 15A-146(b1) - exact approved form is not recorded' and its destination as 'not recorded - exact filing court for the separate G.S. 15A-146(b1) application requires source confirmation'. It also directs that the branch be preserved 'without inventing another approved-track source identity or importing its facts into the ordinary dismissal packet'.

measuredEvidence.finding: 'G.S. 15A-146(c) requires any petition under this section to be on a form approved by the Administrative Office of the Courts.' The approved form for the (b1) branch is the one thing the record says is not recorded.

measuredEvidence.measurement: the Master Library North Carolina legal review, ASOF 2026-08-01
measuredEvidence.finding: It lists DNA expunction under SELF-HELP LIMITS and again among the attorney-handoff triggers, and records at correction 8 that the DNA application route inside 15A-146(b1) is missing from the internal reference, including its 20-day service requirement on the district attorney.

measuredEvidence.measurement: the AOC criminal forms index held in custody under private/source-imports/Nationwide_Recovery_Pool_2026-09-02/LegalEase North Carolina
measuredEvidence.finding: Expunction forms are listed under G.S. 15A-146(a), (a1) and (a2). No form is listed under 15A-146(b1). The two DNA-record expunction forms in the index are AOC-CR-284 under G.S. 15A-148 and AOC-CR-293 under G.S. 15A-145.8(b), which are different statutes and different routes. The index is paginated, so this is a positive finding about what it names and not a proof of exhaustiveness.

whyNotBuiltAnyway: Composing a (b1) application would have required inventing the instrument's identity, its approved-form status and its filing court, all three of which the controlling record expressly records as not recorded. G.S. 15A-146(c), as the record states it, requires any petition under this section to be on an AOC-approved form.

Promoting AOC-CR-287 as this route's filing instrument would have promoted a source whose printed statutory identity conflicts with the route, which is the source-fidelity defect this factory exists to prevent.
Falling back to a guidance-only deliverable would have changed this family's delivery type. That is an owner decision, not a build-lane one, and the queue row's ownerDeliveryTypeRefusal is null.
rows.exactLegalQuestionForTheOwner: What exact filing instrument, component set, filing destination and fee treatment are approved for the G.S. 15A-146(b1) DNA-expunction application? Specifically: is there an AOC-approved form for a (b1) application, and if there is not, what does G.S. 15A-146(c)'s AOC-approved-form requirement mean for that branch? Until that is answered and a form is bound by hash, this route has no instrument a packet can carry.
